method: Forty wrapped parcels, nine shirts with folded sleeves on individual hangers, a supported tubular rail, padded ironing table and cantilever sleeve board. Exact retained source rectangles, heights and owners govern fitting. Parcel undersides extend five millimetres to their existing shelves. The table fills the original ten-millimetre pad gap. Two rail suspension rods terminate on the authored ceiling. New cloth uses the existing catalogued runtime linen maps and their locked 0.6 metre scale; paper, timber and chrome retain their original shipping variants. No catalogue definition, trade mechanism, actor, hours or utility service is replaced. The retained variant-0 receiving hull determines the right-hand stop of the table and pad. Preserve a 30 mm gap to that hull and the original 40 mm pad overhang. Shorten this end and reseat its two legs and aprons; all original source rectangles remain comparison authority. Cabinet pose, programme, cloth stock and utility authority remain.
open_work: Six receiving chassis still need their period furniture. The separately fitted tubs, wringer, irons and airers remain passive; operating services, tickets, rear workshop access and whole-building acceptance remain open.
